    . After a six-year absence, the character recently returned to Port Charles on April 17, 2026, portrayed by original actor
    Nathan Dean
     (formerly credited as Nathan Parsons).

    Character Profile and History 
    Ethan first arrived in Port Charles in 2009 as a "charismatic drifter" and grifter. His debut storyline centered on a paternity mystery, initially suggesting he might be the son of either Luke Spencer or
    Robert Scorpio
    . 
    • Family Ties: He is the half-brother of
      Lucky Spencer
       and
      Lulu Spencer
      . Recently, it was revealed that he is also the half-brother of
      Sasha Gilmore
       through their mother, Holly.
    • Key Relationships: Ethan is known for a complex history with
      Kristina Corinthos-Davis
      , who harbored a crush on him as a teenager. He was once married to
      Maya Ward
       following a drunken night in Las Vegas.
    • Abuse Scandal: In a significant past storyline, Kristina falsely accused Ethan of assaulting her to protect her actual abuser, Kiefer Bauer. This led to Ethan being targeted by mob boss
      Sonny Corinthos
       before the truth was revealed.       
    Actor and Return Details 
    The role was originated by Nathan Parsons in 2009. The actor now uses the professional name Nathan Dean, a choice he made during his time on Roswell, New Mexico to reinvent himself and pay homage to James Dean. 
    Actor History 
    Recast
    Current 2026 Storyline 
    Ethan's April 2026 return coincided with his desire to pay respects following the off-screen death of his father, Luke Spencer (played by the late Anthony Geary). Upon his return, he immediately reconnected with his sister, Lulu. Spoilers suggest his return may involve helping Sonny Corinthos take down criminals Jenz Sidwell and Ross Cullum.
